channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: No. 5 Indians wreck Bulldogs’ home opener, 15-2
item.description: No. 5 Catawba spoils Barton’s home opener with a 15-2, run-rule win, hammering 3 homers and 15 hits as Matthew Connolly drives in 4 runs and Parker Lakey earns the victory at Nixon Field.

item.title: Top-ranked Tigers swat Eagles to clinch tie for ECAC title
item.description: Top-ranked Wilson Prep rolled to its 16th straight win and clinched at least a share of the ECAC girls basketball title with a rout of Sallie B. Howard, led by Paris Best’s 15 points.

item.title: Wilson Prep bombs Sallie B to keep share of ECAC lead
item.description: Freshman Trey Atkinson hit six threes and scored a career-high 18 points as Wilson Prep pulled away from Sallie B. Howard 75-51, extending its ECAC win streak to three and keeping a share of the league lead.

item.title: ‘We refuse to be silent’: 3-day march to Raleigh begins at St. James Christian Church
item.description: More than 100 people joined the Rev. William Barber at St. James Christian Church to launch a three-day march from Wilson to Raleigh, rallying for voting rights, justice and politics grounded in love.

item.title: Parent charged after child takes gun to school
item.description: A Lucama man is charged with contributing to the delinquency of a minor after his child took an unloaded gun to Sallie B. Howard School, where faculty secured the weapon without incident.

item.title: Fence goes up around mall
item.description: A D.H. Griffin crew has started preliminary work for the demolition of the former Wilson Mall.

item.title: Chamber hosting forum on health care
item.description: The Wilson Chamber of Commerce will host the inaugural ReAlign Issues Forum on health care at Wilson Community College on Feb. 26.

item.title: Area Calendar, Feb. 12-13, 2026
item.description: Area sports schedule for Feb. 12-13, 2026, featuring Barton college teams and a full slate of high school basketball, wrestling and JV tournament action across the region.

item.title: Taking off our 'armor' may be the toughest, strongest play we can make
item.description: Former Duke goalkeeper E.J. Proctor reflects on a heartbreaking Duke-UNC finish, Coach K’s “Brotherhood,” and why dropping our emotional armor can be the strongest move in sports and life.

item.title: Farris & Thomas Law Student-Athlete of the Week: Kaci Collins, Fike High
item.description: Fike High senior swimmer Kaci Collins, a 4.3 GPA student and multi-sport athlete active in church and YMCA programs, is the Farris & Thomas Law Student-Athlete of the Week.
